description: Still de moda sem pessoa: peça de vestuário disposta como objeto, com foco em tecido, ponto e queda. Uso: catálogo editorial, look book, cover art.

ask_before.prompt: Abertura: tipo de peça, disposição na cena, superfície e altura. Ex.: 'A wool blazer draped over a raw-timber bench, sleeves crossed and one lapel folded'.
Peças na cena, cada uma com tecido, trama, vincos de tensão e caimento. Um still de moda que não descreve tecido em detalhe cai no vale da uniformidade.
Superfícies do cenário (mesa, madeira, tecido de fundo) — cada uma declara acabamento e resposta especular. Zero se o fundo for seamless.
Proporção. Recomendado 4:5 vertical para catálogo, 1:1 para carrossel.

camera.height: 45 degrees above the surface, looking three quarters down at the garment

in_focus: the collar and the near sleeve seam
out_of_focus: the back edge of the surface softens progressively

camera.perspective_note: 80mm on medium format at 1.4 metres holds the garment proportions without perspective distortion of the near lapel

optics.bokeh_character: shallow progressive falloff on the far side of the garment with no swirl at the frame edge

sources.modifier: 1.2 by 1.8 metre softbox overhead camera-left, tilted at 30 degrees
large white bounce card camera-right at the surface level

penumbra.location: along the garment folds where the fabric folds against the surface

lighting.shadow_direction: falls down and camera-right across the surface, consistent for the garment and any props
lighting.contact_shadow: the shadow of the garment on the surface is dense along the fold lines and opens into a soft penumbra away from the fabric

render.palette_note: warm midtones, restrained saturation on the wardrobe colour
render.highlight_rolloff: gradual rolloff on the specular fibre highlights without clipping
render.black_point: deepest shadow inside the folds near 6 percent luminance
render.grain: fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 100

frame.composition: garment centred with air on all four sides; leading edge of the fabric pointing toward the lower-right
frame.headroom: even margin of roughly 10 percent above the highest fabric point

imperfection_budget.specific: one thread along the lapel seam sits fractionally proud of the rest, catching the specular
one fold has settled asymmetrically and reads slightly off the intended styling

defaults.capture_reality: A single frame from a working catalogue session
avoid: uniform fibre response across the whole garment

example_answers.meta.user_request: still editorial de um blazer de lã sobre uma bancada de madeira crua para look book de outono
example_answers.scene.headline: Studio garment still. A charcoal wool-crepe blazer draped over a raw-oak bench, one lapel folded back, sleeves crossed over the seat

wardrobe.weave: the wool shows its twill weave under the key light, with a fine directional grain along the shoulder
tension_creases: compression creases at the inner elbow of the folded sleeve
a slight roll where the lapel folds back on itself
a diagonal crease from the button across the front where the fabric collapses
wardrobe.drape: the wool falls with heavy structured weight, holding broad folds without any fluid movement
wardrobe.wear: very faint pilling at the elbow fold, imperceptible except under the direct specular

materials.surface: raw-oak bench top with visible saw marks
materials.specular_response: the wood grain scatters the key into a broad directional sheen along the grain, with the saw marks reading as fine linear specular breaks

materials.surface: matte concrete floor 30 centimetres below the bench
materials.specular_response: returns a soft diffuse fill with no legible reflection
